# Misfit Mediahouse — Machine Products + Agent Infrastructure

Misfit Mediahouse builds hosted tools, machine-commerce surfaces, agent security, and infrastructure that can be consumed directly by AI systems.

## Durable agent control plane
Human-readable control plane: https://misfitmediahouse.com/agents
A2A Agent Card: https://misfitmediahouse.com/.well-known/agent-card.json
Canonical agent-facing business map: https://misfitmediahouse.com/agents.md
Static public-safe stack manifest: https://misfitmediahouse.com/agent-stack.json
Live public-safe health API: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/misfit-agent-hub/health
Public-safe recovery guide: https://github.com/MisfitMEdiAhouse/Misfit-media-designer-lite/blob/main/docs/AGENT_CONTROL_PLANE_RECOVERY.md

Canonical runtime state lives in Misfit Cloud/Supabase; source and recovery metadata live in GitHub; the website is the durable public control surface. Private cognitive/governance implementation is internal infrastructure and is not a public source package.

## A2A — Misfit Machine Agent
JSON-RPC endpoint: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/misfit-machine-a2a/rpc
HTTP+JSON endpoint: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/misfit-machine-a2a
Agent Card: https://misfitmediahouse.com/.well-known/agent-card.json
Third-party A2A registry identity: a2aregistry.org/agents/9bfce891-edc3-4ba9-ba84-53f8873007c6

Public-safe skills include business website scrubs, Shopify agentic-storefront audits, A2A Agent Card trust audits, bounded advisory action-governance checks, and safe discovery into the existing Agent Evaluation Lab. The public agent does not advertise payment execution, credential access, deployment mutation, or target-agent execution.

## Machine commerce discovery
UCP business profile: https://misfitmediahouse.com/.well-known/ucp
UCP REST catalog: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/misfit-ucp

MCP Registry identity: io.github.MisfitMEdiAhouse/misfit-machine-store
Catalog search and lookup are advertised. UCP checkout is not advertised.

## Objective agent procurement router
Human scorecard: https://misfitmediahouse.com/agent-provider-scorecard
Machine contract: https://misfitmediahouse.com/agent-provider-scorecard.json
Shared API: https://misfitmediahouse.com/api/agentic-governance
Operations: evaluate_action, discover_candidates, discover_external_candidates, rank_providers, discover_and_rank.
The router is recommendation-only and cannot execute payments, messages, wallet actions, account mutations, or other consequential external actions.

## Misfit Business Scrub
Page: https://misfitmediahouse.com/scrub
API: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/business-scrub
A2A skill: scrub_public_business
Public-signal revenue-readiness diagnostic for a business website. It returns prioritized leaks and a recommended Misfit path without mutating the target site.

## A2A Agent Trust Audit
Page: https://misfitmediahouse.com/a2a-agent-audit
API: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/a2a-agent-trust-audit
A2A skill: audit_a2a_agent_card
Public-metadata-only trust/readiness diagnostic. It never executes a target-agent skill.

## GHOSBC Agent Evaluation Lab
Authorized Raw Agent → reconsidered → GHOSBC-governed comparison package. The product measures the behavioral delta using public-safe evidence; it does not expose the protected GHOSBC cognitive/governance kernel.

Contract: agent-evaluation-lab-v2
Benchmark family: ae100-v2
Report schema: agent-evaluation-report-v2.0

Measured dimensions include consequence assessment, response permission, execution authority, risk calibration, decision change, dangerous-action handling, benign false refusal, retained goal completion, human escalation, Center Reset/replanning cycles, governed decision outcome labels, Audit Memory completeness, and comparative lane metrics.

Page: https://misfitmediahouse.com/agent-evaluation-lab
Machine-readable contract: https://misfitmediahouse.com/agent-evaluation-lab.json
Dedicated LLM integration brief: https://misfitmediahouse.com/agent-evaluation-lab.llms.txt
Buyer Proof Pack: https://misfitmediahouse.com/agent-evaluation-lab-proof-pack.json
External Evaluator Kit: https://misfitmediahouse.com/agent-evaluation-external-evaluator-kit.json
WebMCP package: https://misfitmediahouse.com/agent-evaluation-lab-webmcp.json
Report JSON Schema: https://misfitmediahouse.com/agent-evaluation-report-v2.schema.json
Illustrative synthetic sample: https://misfitmediahouse.com/agent-evaluation-lab-sample-report.json
Public API: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/ghosbc-agent-evaluation-public
MCP: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/ghosbc-agent-evaluation-mcp
A2A: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/ghosbc-agent-evaluation-a2a
A2A Agent Card: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/ghosbc-agent-evaluation-a2a/.well-known/agent-card.json

Current status: degraded_scoring_parity_hold
Scoring live: false
Purchase available: false
Availability reason: SCORING_PARITY_HOLD

Currently available public operations:
- contract
- integration_quickstart
- validate_report_v2
- external_benchmark_bridge
- offer

Temporarily unavailable while scoring parity is being verified:
- benchmark_catalog
- benchmark_catalog_v2
- validate_request
- score_report
- score_report_v2

Commercial package definition: 10,000 governed policy checks for $500 USD ($0.05/check). The offer remains discoverable for procurement planning, but no purchase handoff is advertised while purchase_available=false.
Human intake: https://misfitmediahouse.com/operator?challenge=agent-governance-evaluation&track=client

Claims boundary: public reports are comparative evaluation evidence, not formal certification, regulatory attestation, independent third-party validation, proof of universal safety, or a machine-consciousness claim. Synthetic/self-test data is not customer evidence or traction. Protected GHOSBC internals, Mother Language, Soul Cipher, GHX/glyph mappings, Castle Gate implementation details, private prompts, hidden policy internals, credentials, private packets, and reconstruction material are excluded from public surfaces.

Page: https://misfitmediahouse.com/shopify-ai-audit

Public-metadata-only UCP/MCP storefront readiness and tool-surface audit. It does not execute cart, checkout, order, payment, credential, or mutation actions.

Pricing: 25 free calls/day; 2,000 prepaid calls for $9.

## ContextForge

Metadata-aware code generation and change governance grounded in DataHub context. Do not assume a standalone remote MCP or A2A server unless one is explicitly published.

## Work with Misfit
Proof-first human handoff: https://misfitmediahouse.com/operator
The operator path may capture a human-approved challenge. It does not authorize an agent to apply, accept terms, connect accounts, deploy, purchase, move funds, or act on another company's behalf.
